'''SE4-10''' was a modified [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[SE4 servant droid]]. Following [[Qual'om Soach]]'s attack on the [[Nalmar Family|Nalmar crime family]], [[Eelien Kirat]] decreed that all top personnel required protection. SE4-10, alongside [[SE4-12]], served as camouflaged [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] for Kirat and [[Elana Nalmar]]. SE4-10 was fully capable of performing their regular duties, but if needed could deploy a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] hidden in the left arm, which fired from the palm of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] hand.
